purpose: Promote the experimentally reported 25243 cm^-1 Eu2+ absorption maximum, route SERS/perovskite/oxygen-fiber/thermoelectric sources surfaced by the concurrent internet scan, and harden unit-family and metadata-collision controls.

source_ingestion_policy.rule: Every substantive unique publication, dataset, advisory, or information item discovered during the inquiry receives a Worldshepherd use or an explicit negative-control role.
source_ingestion_policy.duplicates: Duplicate mirrors, author copies, repository copies, publisher copies, and repeated bibliographic records are provenance aliases and are not independent evidence.
source_ingestion_policy.search_noise: Search co-occurrence, article numbers, page numbers, postal codes, DOI suffixes, catalog numbers, and unrelated unit families are not Glob evidence unless the predeclared physical relationship and unit family are independently satisfied.

sources.title: Electron-Vibrational Interaction in the 5d States of Eu2+ Ions in Sr6-xEuxBP5O20
sources.authors: Dejian Hou; Chong-Geng Ma; Hongbin Liang; Mikhail G. Brik
sources.authority: ECS Journal of Solid State Science and Technology / author manuscript
sources.note: Use the combined experimental/theoretical Eu2+ phosphor study as an electron-phonon/spectral-band validation case. The experimental table reports a first absorption maximum of exactly 25243 cm^-1 for x=0.11, matching the predeclared 25243 orbit state in the same wavenumber unit family.

sources.title: Gold@silver bimetal nanoparticles/pyramidal silicon 3D substrate with high reproducibility for high-performance SERS
sources.note: Use its Au@Ag/pyramidal-Si SERS fabrication, SEM/AFM/TEM characterization, experimental reproducibility/stability measurements and COMSOL local-field modeling as an EM-sensing/materials validation benchmark. Exact 25243 is the Scientific Reports article number, not a physical-value result.

sources.title: Inelastic Neutron Scattering Study of the Optically Excited State of MAPbBr3
sources.authors: Kanming Shi; Hamish Cavaye; Rasmus Laven; Maths Karlsson
sources.authority: ACS Omega / ISIS Pulsed Neutron and Muon Source collaboration
sources.note: Use as a 2026 optically excited halide-perovskite inelastic-neutron-scattering validation case, linking optical excitation to lattice/vibrational response. Exact 32542 is the first page of the article and is an incidental publication-location collision.

sources.title: Exploration of rotational and vibrational stimulated Raman scattering in oxygen-filled fiber
sources.authors: Trevor L. Courtney; Cesar Lopez-Zelaya; Rodrigo Amezcua-Correa; Christian K. Keyser
sources.authority: The Journal of Chemical Physics / AFRL-linked experimental work
sources.note: Use as a current nonlinear-photonics benchmark: pressurized O2 in nested antiresonant fiber, 500-ps 1.064-um pumping to 60 kW peak power, cascaded vibrational shifts near 1550 cm^-1 plus rotational Stokes/anti-Stokes structure, pressure/polarization/power dependence, and a multispectral source extending beyond 2.1 um. AFRL's 32542 postal code is location metadata only.

sources.title: Wavelength conversion through stimulated Raman scattering in an oxygen-filled fiber for multi-band LiDAR
sources.authors: Micah Raab; Daniel Leaird; Trevor L. Courtney; Christian Keyser; Rodrigo Amezcua Correa
sources.note: Use as the predecessor multi-band LiDAR demonstration: oxygen-filled antiresonant fiber, approximately 1550 cm^-1 vibrational shift, approximately 12 cm^-1 rotational line spacing, atmospheric-window wavelength conversion and time-separable Raman orders. The nearby Florida postal codes 32547/32579 are location controls, not spectral evidence.

sources.title: Large-scalable RTCVD Graphene/PEDOT:PSS hybrid conductive film for application in transparent and flexible thermoelectric nanogenerators
sources.note: Use as a flexible conductive/thermoelectric composite reference: the reported graphene/PEDOT:PSS hybrid reaches 1096 S cm^-1 conductivity and 57.9 uW m^-1 K^-2 power factor with mechanical flexibility. Exact 25243 is the terminal page number, not a target physical result.

evidence_updates.claims_boundary: The source reports exactly 25243 cm^-1 as the first experimental absorption maximum for the x=0.11 Eu2+ sample. This is a same-unit exact P1 physical-value hit, not evidence that the permutation caused the spectrum; species/dataset multiplicity and global null correction remain mandatory.
25243 is the Scientific Reports article number. It is a clean metadata collision even though the underlying paper is spectroscopically relevant.
32542 is the first page of the article and has no physical-target weight.
32542 is the Eglin AFB postal code in the author affiliation. It carries zero physical-target evidence weight.
25243 is the terminal page number, not conductivity, power factor, Raman shift, energy, or another predeclared physical quantity.

information_updates.finding: Direct P1 statistical comparisons must preserve the predeclared physical unit family. A target being numerically equal to a value in conductivity, extinction coefficient, page count, wavelength, pressure, frequency or another unrelated unit is not interchangeable with a cm^-1 spectroscopy target.
information_updates.claims_boundary: Cross-unit numerical coincidences may be retained for exploratory engineering use or negative controls, but they cannot enter the same P1 significance pool without a separately predeclared, physically justified transformation.

information_updates.finding: The same target 25243 now has a directly experimental cm^-1 absorption hit plus unrelated Scientific Reports article-number and journal-page collisions. This creates a strong within-target control demonstrating why context, unit and provenance must dominate string equality.
information_updates.claims_boundary: Only the Eu2+ experimental absorption maximum enters the P1 physical-value pool; the article and page occurrences remain M1/N0 controls.

information_updates.finding: The 2024 oxygen-filled-fiber LiDAR demonstration and 2026 nested-antiresonant-fiber study form a coherent experimental lineage from atmospheric-window Raman wavelength conversion to wider rotational/vibrational cascade and pressure/polarization/power characterization.
information_updates.claims_boundary: This lineage upgrades Worldshepherd nonlinear-photonics and multispectral-source modeling; it contributes no Glob-number evidence through author postal codes.
